# tutti

> An open audio project format: a project is a plain folder holding one JSON document, the audio
> it plays, the plugin states it uses and a short README. Start a project in one program, open it
> in another, including programs that don't exist yet. MIT, pre-alpha, version 1.0 in draft.

Read `docs/agent-guide.md` first: how to read and write a project, the time model and the model in a
paragraph each, the smallest valid document, common tasks and pitfalls.

## Normative

- [The format](spec/1.0/tutti.md): the folder, the document, identity, time, the model,
  devices and states, extensions and versions, robustness.
- [Conformance](spec/1.0/conformance.md): what every reader and writer must do; Levels 0, 1
  and 2 and their fixtures.
- [Extensions](spec/1.0/extensions.md): namespaces, used and required, the registry, adoption
  into the core.
- [The JSON Schema](schema/1.0/tutti.schema.json): what an agent's structured output
  validates against.

## Guides

- [For agents and implementers](docs/agent-guide.md)
- [The README every project folder carries](spec/1.0/README.template.md)
- [The research the format was designed from](docs/research.md)
- [Why each choice was made](NOTES.md)

## Code

- `crates/tutti`: the reference implementation, `Project` (the save procedure over a store
  trait) included; no file IO, builds for WebAssembly.
- `crates/tutti-fs`: the disk; `open` and `create` give a `Project` for a folder.
- `crates/tutti-cli`: `tutti check`, `tutti inspect`, `tutti deps`, `tutti archive`, `tutti zip`,
  `tutti unzip`.
- `js/`: `@mxm-audio/tutti`, the npm package (the core compiled to WebAssembly).
- `examples/`: example projects and the conformance fixtures.
